tasks.title: Implement Comprehensive Mobile Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Implement comprehensive mobile responsive design for the calculator application.

**Files to read first:**
- index.html
- src/App.css
- src/components/Calculator.css
- src/components/Button.css
- src/components/Display.css
- src/components/Calculator.tsx

**Changes required:**

1. **Verify viewport meta tag** in index.html:
   - Ensure it has: <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

2. **Update src/components/Calculator.css:**
   - Add responsive width/max-width for different screen sizes
   - Use flexbox for flexible layouts
   - Add media queries for mobile (max-width: 480px), tablet (481px-768px), and desktop (769px+)
   - Ensure proper spacing and padding that adapts to screen size
   - Make calculator width fluid with max-width constraints

3. **Update src/components/Button.css:**
   - Ensure minimum touch target size of 44x44px on mobile
   - Add responsive font sizes using media queries
   - Adjust padding for mobile devices
   - Ensure buttons scale appropriately

4. **Update src/components/Display.css:**
   - Make display text responsive (font-size should scale with viewport)
   - Ensure text doesn't overflow on small screens
   - Add proper padding/margins for mobile
   - Use clamp() or media queries for font sizing

5. **Update src/App.css:**
   - Ensure container adapts to mobile viewports
   - Add responsive layout rules
   - Center calculator properly on all screen sizes
   - Use viewport-relative units where appropriate

**Write or update tests:**
- Update tests in src/components/Calculator.test.tsx to verify responsive behavior
- Test that component renders correctly
- Add tests for button sizing and layout if not present

**Screenshot verification:**
After implementing changes:
1. Start dev server: npm run dev
2. Use Playwright to capture screenshots at:
   - Mobile: 375x667px
   - Tablet: 768x1024px
   - Desktop: 1920x1080px
3. Save to .eunomia/screenshots/developer/
4. Read screenshots to verify layout correctness

**Follow existing conventions:**
- Match existing CSS naming patterns
- Use same indentation style
- Don't add new dependencies
acceptance_criteria: Calculator displays correctly on mobile viewports (320px-480px width)
Calculator displays correctly on tablet viewports (481px-768px width)
Calculator displays correctly on desktop viewports (769px+ width)
All buttons have minimum 44x44px touch targets on mobile
Display text is readable without zooming on all screen sizes
Layout adapts gracefully without horizontal scrolling
All existing tests continue to pass

tasks.title: Validate Mobile Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Validate that the mobile responsive design has been properly implemented.

**Test execution:**
1. Run full test suite: npm test
2. Verify all tests pass without failures
3. Check that responsive behavior tests execute successfully

**Visual validation:**
1. Start dev server: npm run dev
2. Use Playwright to test multiple viewport sizes:
   - Mobile: 375x667px (iPhone SE)
   - Mobile: 414x896px (iPhone 11 Pro Max)
   - Tablet: 768x1024px (iPad)
   - Desktop: 1920x1080px
3. Capture screenshots for each viewport
4. Verify:
   - Calculator fits within viewport without horizontal scroll
   - Buttons are easily tappable (not too small)
   - Display text is readable
   - Layout is centered and visually balanced
   - No overlapping elements
   - Proper spacing maintained

**Review developer screenshots:**
- Check .eunomia/screenshots/developer/ for mobile.png, tablet.png, desktop.png
- Verify these show proper responsive layout

**Acceptance check:**
- All tests pass
- Visual verification confirms responsive behavior
- No regressions in existing functionality
acceptance_criteria: Calculator renders correctly on mobile viewports (320px-480px)
Calculator renders correctly on tablet viewports (481px-768px)
Calculator renders correctly on desktop viewports (769px+)
No horizontal scrolling on any viewport size
Touch targets are adequately sized for mobile interaction
